  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairVideo" name="Video of the repair"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone sent for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_User" name="DIY repair of a broken smartphone screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="User_Start" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="User_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="User_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="User_CheckItems" name="Identify materials and tools already on hand"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="User_FriendsDecision" name="Can friends provide items to borrow or buy cheaply?" default="User_NoFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="User_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply" messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="User_FriendsMerge" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="User_BuyRemaining" name="Buy the remaining materials and tools"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="User_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive instructions for fixing the phone" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="User_RepairPhone" name="Fix the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="User_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?" default="User_RepairFailed"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="User_FeedbackSplit" name="Send a review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="User_SendReview" name="Send a review" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="User_SendVideo" name="Send a video of fixing the phone" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="User_FeedbackJoin" name="Finish sending review and/or video"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="User_EndSuccess" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="User_SendToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="User_EndExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_01" sourceRef="User_Start" targetRef="User_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_02" sourceRef="User_EnterDetails" targetRef="User_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_03" sourceRef="User_ReceiveLists" targetRef="User_CheckItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_04" sourceRef="User_CheckItems" targetRef="User_FriendsDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_05" name="Friends can provide items" sourceRef="User_FriendsDecision" targetRef="User_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">friendsCanHelp</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="User_NoFriends" name="No friends can provide items" sourceRef="User_FriendsDecision" targetRef="User_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_07" sourceRef="User_ContactFriends" targetRef="User_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_08" sourceRef="User_FriendsMerge" targetRef="User_BuyRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_09" sourceRef="User_BuyRemaining" targetRef="User_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_10" sourceRef="User_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="User_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_11" sourceRef="User_RepairPhone" targetRef="User_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_12" name="Repair worked" sourceRef="User_RepairOutcome" targetRef="User_FeedbackSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairWorked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="User_RepairFailed" name="Repair did not work" sourceRef="User_RepairOutcome" targetRef="User_SendToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_14" name="Send review" sourceRef="User_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="User_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendReview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_15" name="Send video" sourceRef="User_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="User_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">sendVideo</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_16" sourceRef="User_SendReview" targetRef="User_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_17" sourceRef="User_SendVideo" targetRef="User_FeedbackJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_18" sourceRef="User_FeedbackJoin" targetRef="User_EndSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="U_Flow_19" sourceRef="User_SendToExpert" targetRef="User_EndExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OnlineTool" name="Online repair tool" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Tool_Start" name="Phone details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Tool_StartMessageDefinition" messageRef="Message_PhoneDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Tool_ProvideLists" name="Provide materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Tool_ProvideInstructions" name="Provide instructions for fixing the phone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Tool_End" name="Repair information provided"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_01" sourceRef="Tool_Start" targetRef="Tool_ProvideLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_02" sourceRef="Tool_ProvideLists" targetRef="Tool_ProvideInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="T_Flow_03" sourceRef="Tool_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="Tool_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair" name="DIY smartphone repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_User" name="Person repairing the phone" processRef="Process_User"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online repair tool" processRef="Process_OnlineTool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneDetails" sourceRef="User_EnterDetails" targetRef="Tool_Start" messageRef="Message_PhoneDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ItemLists" sourceRef="Tool_ProvideLists" targetRef="User_ReceiveLists" messageRef="Message_ItemLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairInstructions" sourceRef="Tool_ProvideInstructions" targetRef="User_ReceiveInstructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Friends" sourceRef="User_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendContact"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Review" sourceRef="User_SendReview" targetRef="Participant_Tool" messageRef="Message_Review"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Video" sourceRef="User_SendVideo" targetRef="Participant_Tool" messageRef="Message_RepairVideo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Expert" sourceRef="User_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
